name: comp_vocal_lead_rock
description: Vocal lead rock — 4:1 leveling for consistent presence without crushing dynamic phrasing
notes: 5 ms attack catches transients but lets initial breath through. 100 ms release follows the natural phrasing. +6 dB makeup compensates the typical -8 dB average reduction. Always followed by a de-esser (the comp amplifies sibilance peaks).
